title: Mom’s Meatloaf
tagline: Lean sirloin with Romano and Worcestershire, shaped like a bread loaf with a channel down the middle to hold more ketchup.

items: 2½ lbs. lean ground sirloin (96% lean or leaner)
1 large sweet or Spanish onion — chopped
1 cup lightly-packed, freshly grated Pecorino Romano cheese

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl combine all ingredients except for the ketchup.

Fold mixture into a 9½ × 5½ × 3 inch Teflon-coated loaf pan. Shape the top of the loaf like a loaf of bread, sloping the sides. Press an indentation down the center top of the loaf lengthwise, to capture more ketchup on top.
Squeeze a generous quantity of ketchup over the loaf, filling in the top and completely covering the meat (it may be more than 1 cup — I never measured!).

Place in the center of the oven and bake for 1½ hours. Ketchup should be slightly brown and juices bubbling. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing into thick slices. HINT: place a square of heavy aluminum foil on the rack below the loaf pan to catch spills.
Always serve with homemade mashed potatoes, 2 packages brown gravy mix prepared with a little red wine added to the gravy, green beans, and hot, crusty French baguettes to round out the meal!
